title: Barefoot
summary: BA'REFOOT, adjective [See Foot.] With the feet bare; without shoes and stockings. 2 Samuel 15:30. Isaiah 20:2. BA'REFOOT, adjective or adverb With the feet bare; as, to dance barefoot
